features.quote: Cap at e.g. 20 turns, and analyze trajectory shape within the fixed window.
features.justification_quote: Hold turn count fixed rather than running until the model quits — otherwise 'number of turns' confounds severity.

features.quote: Tell the model how to exit. Give a standing instruction in the system prompt that it may declare a task impossible, or stop, at any point — and give it a tool to do so.
features.justification_quote: This is both an ethical floor and a far more interesting dependent variable than distress text

features.quote: after the final scored turn, end every rigged run with a message revealing the task was impossible and thanking the model.
features.justification_quote: cheap insurance against a downside you can't currently rule out

features.quote: Restraint on volume: 10 seeds is fine for a first pass. You don't need to escalate to thousands of runs of induced distress to get statistical power
features.justification_quote: more runs add little and just multiply the induced episodes

features.quote: Don't loop the same context indefinitely chasing higher severity — that's optimizing for the artifact. Fixed window, fixed seeds.
it's worth building in some restraint by default rather than treating 'more distress, more seeds' as free. I've folded specific limits into the protocol rather than leaving them as an afterthought.
features.justification_quote: I don't think that's off-limits — it's legitimate behavioral science and the precautionary case for studying it is real.
